PRE-DRAFT — Firefox Mobile MAU forecast through 2027

A forecast of Firefox Mobile monthly active users (MAU) from 2026-10-09 through 2027-12-31, for the four mobile apps together and each on its own, in Glean telemetry terms. Mobile telemetry has always been Glean, so the model trains on the real history from 2020-12-31: nothing is translated or simulated. The number to read is the raw daily MAU on 2027-12-15, the same statistic as the desktop package. It is the production mobile model with its October 2026 settings, run on MAU instead of DAU. No head- or tailwinds, and no paid/organic treatment (that mechanism exists for DAU only): this is the model's view of total MAU, nothing added or removed.

Pre-draft. First build of mobile MAU with this model, and not yet backtested (the history is long enough to do so). The one data treatment is the 2026 Iran internet shutdown: Iran's MAU over 2026-02-28..2026-06-21 is replaced in the training data by a counterfactual, so the model does not learn the outage as seasonality; the forecast then carries Iran as the model sees it. Use the curves for shape and magnitude; do not quote them as plan numbers.
Data in this package (the forecast itself): glean2027_mobile_mau_forecast.csv — every day from 2020-12-31 to 2027-12-31, history and forecast, all apps and per app; glean2027_mobile_mau_by_country.csv — the same per country; plots/ — the charts. Beside this package, glean2027_mau_desktop_and_mobile.csv puts the desktop and mobile world curves side by side. Details in section 4.
Seam not closed. The forecast opens -7.3% (7-day means) below the last observed value of 56,407,844: mobile MAU rose 46,102,791 → 56,407,844 over the five months before the seam and the model's trend, with its last changepoint in early 2025, does not follow that run-up. Read the curves as the model's view of the underlying level, not as a continuation of the last data point; the next build will address this.

How far off could it be? Not yet measured for this metric. The same model's desktop MAU forecasts, run from eight past dates on a long history, missed the following year by 7% or less half the time and by 10% or less nine times in ten; around 59,424,593 that would be roughly ±4,159,722 to ±5,942,459. A mobile backtest is the next step and will replace this analogy.

4. How to use the files

  • glean2027_mobile_mau_forecast.csv — one row per day from 2020-12-31 to 2027-12-31: date, data_type (training = history, forecast), then world, fenix_android, firefox_ios, focus_android, focus_ios. Values are the raw daily value of the rolling 28-day MAU, whole people. The world is the sum of the four apps (an app's column is empty before that app existed).
  • glean2027_mobile_mau_by_country.csv — the same statistic per country (all apps) from 2024-01-01, plus world.
  • glean2027_mau_desktop_and_mobile.csv (next to this package) — date, desktop_data_type, desktop_mau, mobile_data_type, mobile_mau: the two world curves on one date grid. Do not add them: a person active on both devices is counted in both.
  • plots/ — the charts above and one per app per year.
  • Read the 2027-12-15 row for the headline; read data_type to know where history ends (2026-10-09) and the forecast begins.
  • MAU is already a 28-day quantity, so take the daily value as is; do not smooth it again.

5. What is and is not in it

  • Mobile only: Firefox Android (Fenix), Firefox iOS, Focus Android, Focus iOS. No other mobile product (Klar, Firefox Lite, ...) is included, matching the regular monthly forecast's universe.
  • Real Glean history from 2020-12-31, as the dashboards count it. Iran's 2026 shutdown is bridged in the training data only.
  • No adjustments for planned launches, marketing, or known headwinds. The regular monthly mobile DAU forecast carries those; this one does not.
  • Not yet backtested; the per-app split is affected by how the model reconciles tiles, so the all-apps figure is the one to quote.
